value: A data-only C translation unit consisting of zero-initialized `.bss` and `.sbss` storage for HSD card work areas. Its definitions include a 0x828-byte `JpegWork` object at `hsd_804D2648` rather than merely a `__jmp_buf`-sized object.
rationale: The PR characterizes the unit as data-only, reports matching `.bss` and `.sbss` sections, and corrects the size and semantic layout of `hsd_804D2648` from a jump buffer to a complete `JpegWork`.

value: Provides the data-only translation unit that owns the bulk shared card work-area globals consumed by `hsd_3A94.c`. Keeping these definitions outside the code-bearing card unit preserves named-symbol relocation addressing for the card routines.
rationale: The PR explicitly introduced `hsd_4D11.c` because placing these definitions anywhere in `hsd_3A94.c` caused MWCC to address static arrays through anonymous section anchors and regressed four previously matching functions.

evidence.why: Identifies `hsd_4D11.c` as a new data-only translation unit containing the shared card work-area definitions moved out of `hsd_3A94.c`.
